dedupe_keys.name: usda nass irrigation and water management survey formerly farm and ranch irrigation survey

description: The national survey of irrigation on US farms. The NASS survey guide says the 2023 Irrigation and Water Management Survey, formerly the Farm and Ranch Irrigation Survey, follows the 2022 Census of Agriculture and is the only complete source on irrigation activities and water use across American farms, ranches and horticultural operations, asking producers about water sources and amounts used, acres irrigated by type of system, irrigation by crop, and system investments and energy costs; like the census it runs once every five years on a sample of irrigators. Results are free to download from the 2022 Census of Agriculture online resources and through Quick Stats. Coverage is the United States, with state results. Caveats: the survey is a sample with five-year gaps, and the licence is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives irrigation water sources, pumping energy costs and system types, to model how droughts or power outages affect irrigated agriculture. A related catalogue record is the USDA NASS cold storage survey.
